notes.title: EA SPORTS FC 26 Feedback Update - September 24
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, thanks again for continuing to share your feedback and reporting issues you’ve experienced in FC 26.  We’ve been passing everything you’ve told us to our development team and their investigations and development work are ongoing. 

Our main goal right now is to give you improvements as fast as possible through a series of smaller Title Updates while continuing to investigate reported issues and creating bigger updates down the road. 

In this post we’re sharing the latest status across these areas of improvement:

[list]
[*] Controllers Not Responding
[*] Optimization And Stability 
[*] Unable To Enter Game
[/list]

[h2]Controllers Not Responding[/h2]

[b][u]Status:[/u][/b] Small improvement coming in the next Title Update, but further investigation and updates are needed.

Thanks to your feedback, we’ve found a number of different cases in which your controllers don’t function as you’d expect. Some of the controller issues you’ve reported are impacted by the overall performance of the game, which we touch on in the Optimization and Stability section below. 

For now, we’ve addressed a few cases of unresponsive controllers and you can expect to see that update come later this week in FC 26 version 1.0.2.

We know that this update will not address every single instance of controllers not responding, it’s part of a series of improvements we’re looking to make. We’re still working on more updates in this space and need to take the time to get it right for you.

While we continue to work on these issues, we ask that you please update the firmware on your controllers if you haven’t already:

[url=https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/hardware-network/controller/update-xbox-wireless-controller]Xbox[/url]
[url=https://controller.dl.playstation.net/controller/lang/en/2100004.html]PlayStation[/url]

[h2]Optimization And Stability[/h2]

[u][b]Status: [/b][/u]Investigating, targeting near future updates including v1.0.2.

We continue to take in your feedback on performance losses occurring during gameplay and cutscenes, and our dev groups are investigating a slew of potential causes while preparing updates.

Thanks to your feedback, we have identified an issue related to adjusting display settings (such as V Sync) while Display Mode is set to Borderless.

You can expect to see this issue get addressed in FC 26 version 1.0.2.

We’re working on addressing other performance issues as well, including:

[list]
[*] Performance issues caused by cloth physics in-game.
[*] Situations where another window or overlay disrupts the game, resulting in issues like input loss.
[/list]

As a reminder, PC setups vary greatly, so we ask that you please give us as much information as possible when telling us about performance issues you might be experiencing.

This is what helps us investigate your issues:

[list]
[*] System specs.
[*] Display and graphics settings - Does the issue occur on lower graphics settings?
[*] Controllers in use.
[*] Time/date of issue including time zone.
[*] Game Area/Feature/Mode.
[*] Screenshots/Videos
[*] How often it happens.
[*] EA account username.
[*] Detailed description of the issue you’re experiencing and what was happening before it started occurring.
[/list]

[h2]Unable To Enter Game[/h2]

[u][b]Status: [/b][/u]Further investigations ongoing, previously addressed Advanced Access issue.

While we addressed players not able to get to their Advanced Access last week, we continue to see that some players are still unable to enter the game.

We’re working with players directly to identify a root cause here, and we’ll provide more updates in the future where possible.

Thank you very much for your continued feedback and patience. We’ll provide more updates here as they come in, and you can also follow our dev teams on social media.

The [url=https://www.ea.com/easftracker]EASFC Tracker[/url] is where you can see a selection of what our development team is working on, and you can find us on [url=https://x.com/EAsfcDirect]X[/url] and [url=https://www.whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaypA13GehEPKXQgyM46]WhatsApp[/url] as well.

- The EA SPORTS FC Team

notes.title: EA SPORTS FC 26 (PS5) Review
notes.notes:
As a slightly more than casual football fan, EA’s annual football game has made me far more aware of the beautiful game than ever before, going back to FIFA 13 on PlayStation 3. Since then, I’ve only skipped two years of titles and have seen the series evolve from something basic and barebones into a wealth of features and game modes. Not everything has been positive, but EA Sports FC 26 looks to address some pain points from recent years.

The first thing I want to highlight in EA Sports FC 26 is gameplay. Improvements have been made through two presets: Authentic and Competitive. Authentic is the default for modes such as Play Career and Manager Career, and it focuses on a more realistic football experience. In practice, this means gameplay is slowed down, placing greater emphasis on strategy, immersion and realism.

In practice, the slower pace of gameplay was immediately noticeable. Inch-perfect passing, perfectly timed tackles and other elements were toned down, while... Read more

notes.title: Advanced Access Feedback Update - EA SPORTS FC 26
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you for sharing your feedback and reporting the issues you’ve experienced with FC 26. We’re listening closely and working around the clock to make your experience better. Here’s some of the issues you've told us about so far, and what we're doing about them:
[/p][h3][b]Unable To Enter The Game[/b][/h3][p][b]
Status: Addressed

[/b]When FC 26 first became available, we had an issue where you weren’t able to enter the game. Our teams worked on this problem from the moment it started occurring, and we identified and addressed the cause within an hour and a half of launch.
[/p][h3][b]Controllers Not Responding[/b][/h3][p][b]
Status: Investigating[/b][/p][p]
We’ve heard your feedback about controllers not registering inputs at times or dropping inputs entirely during matches.[/p][p]
We’re investigating the cause of this right now and will provide an update as soon as one is available.[/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t already, be sure to update the firmware on your controller below:[/p][list][*][p][u][url="https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/hardware-network/controller/update-xbox-wireless-controller"]Xbox[/url][/u][/p][/*][*][p][u][url="https://controller.dl.playstation.net/controller/lang/en/2100004.html"]PlayStation[/url][/u][/p][/*][/list][p]
A card for this has been created on the [u][url="https://trello.com/c/u1qX2ZCw"]EASFC Tracker[/url][/u], you can follow along there for updates.[/p][h3]
[b]Online Lag And Delay[/b][/h3][p]
[b]Status: Addressed[/b][/p][p]
We had an issue causing a number of players to connect to FC Game Data Centers that were non-optimal. For example, if you would normally connect to data center A, the issue might have sent you to data center B.[/p][p]
We identified the cause here quickly and our teams were able to address the issue, so the game should no longer be sending players to incorrect FC Game Data Centers.
[/p][h3][b]Missing Content / Season Pass[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Status: Addressed with a potential small workaround needed.[/b][/p][p]
If you’re missing any pre-order in-game content or access to the Season Pass, shutting FC 26 game down fully and restarting while connected to the internet typically enables our backend systems to re-check your content and give it to you.
[/p][p]To learn more about pre-order content and benefits, you can check out [url="https://www.ea.com/games/ea-sports-fc/fc-26/news/pitch-notes-fc26-launch-update"][u]this article[/u][/url].[/p][h3]
[b]Optimization And Stability[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Status: Investigating[/b][/p][p]
We hear your feedback about graphical performance and stability and are investigating reports we see (like the one time freeze on the Squad screen for example). [/p][p]
Since PC setups can vary greatly, we ask that you please give us as much information as possible when telling us about the stability or graphical issues you might be experiencing.[/p][p]
What would be super helpful to us to see is:

- System specs.[/p][p]- Controllers in use.[/p][p]- Time/date of issue including time zone.[/p][p]- Game Area/Feature/Mode.[/p][p]- Screenshots/Videos[/p][p]- How often it happens.[/p][p]- EA account username.[/p][p]- Detailed description of the issue you’re experiencing and what was happening before it started occurring.[/p][p]
We appreciate your patience and support. We’ll provide more updates in the community here as they come in, and you can also get updates from our development teams in a number of different ways.[/p][p]
The [u][url="https://www.ea.com/easftracker"]EASFC Tracker[/url][/u] is where you can see a selection of what our development team is working on, and you can find us on [u][url="https://x.com/EAsfcDirect"]X[/url][/u] and [u][url="https://www.whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaypA13GehEPKXQgyM46"]WhatsApp[/url][/u] as well.[/p][p]
- The EA SPORTS FC Team
[/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: EA SPORTS FC™ 26 | FC 26 PC Deep Dive
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! In the PC Deep Dive Pitch Notes we’re diving into all the ways we’ve improved the PC experience for EA SPORTS FC 26. Thanks to your feedback, we’ve made foundational changes that give you more control, smoother performance, and clearer settings across the board.

Here’s what we’ll cover:

[list]
[*] Controller Support Enhancements
[*] Expanded Display Settings
[*] Improved Graphics Settings Usability
[*] Display Settings Guide
[*] Graphics Settings Guide
[*] PC Requirements
[*] EA Javelin Anticheat
[/list]
[h2]Controller Support Enhancements[/h2]

We know many of you play on PC with controllers, and this year we’ve added more immersive support.

[list]
[*] DualShock®4 Support: Full vibration support when playing on PC with a USB connection.
[*] DualSense™ Controller Support: Includes haptics and adaptive triggers for a more immersive experience with a USB connection (basic vibration support over Bluetooth).
[/list]
[h2]Expanded Display Settings[/h2]

We’ve added more flexibility so you can fine tune FC 26 to match your setup and preferences.

[list]
[*] Active Monitor Selection: Choose which monitor you want to run the game on directly from in-game settings.
[*] Aspect Ratio Filter: Quickly find supported resolutions based on your display’s aspect ratio.
[*] More Frame Rate Limit Options: Frame rate limits now extend beyond 120 FPS, with support for 144, 165, and 240 FPS.
[*] More VSync Options: Sync your frame rate to a fraction of your monitor’s refresh rate (½, ⅓, ¼).
[*] Render Scale: Adjust resolution relative to your render setting, especially useful for windowed or borderless modes.
[*] Dynamic Resolution FPS Target: Set a performance target to trigger dynamic resolution scaling automatically.
[/list]
[h2]Improved Graphics Settings Usability[/h2]

We’ve worked to make PC graphics settings easier to understand and quicker to configure.

[list]
[*] Informative Settings Descriptions: Every graphics setting now includes descriptions and impact details on CPU, GPU, and VRAM usage.
[*] Graphics Quality Presets: Switch between predefined options like Low, Medium, High, Ultra, and Auto to adjust quality settings (restart required to take effect).
[/list]
[h2]Display Settings Guide[/h2]

Here’s a breakdown of key display settings, grouped for easier navigation.

[h3]Screen Setup[/h3]
[list]
[*] Active Monitor (NEW): Choose which monitor displays the game in Borderless or Full Screen.
[*] Display Mode:
Borderless: Fills your screen without borders (cannot be resized).
Fullscreen: Uses your entire screen.
Windowed: Runs in a resizable, movable window.
[*] Aspect Ratio (NEW): Filters resolutions by chosen aspect ratio (Fullscreen only).
[*] Screen Resolution: Sets display resolution. Higher = sharper image, but lower performance (Fullscreen only). Borderless uses OS resolution. Tip: use Render Scale to adjust in Borderless.
[/list]
[h3]Frame Rate & Refresh[/h3]
[list]
[*] Refresh Rate: Controls how often your monitor refreshes (Fullscreen only).
[*] Frame Rate Limit: Caps FPS when VSync is off.
[*] VSync: Syncs FPS to your monitor to prevent tearing.
Off: No sync.
On: Matches refresh rate.
50%, 33%, 25%: Syncs FPS to a fraction of refresh rate.
[Example: On a 240Hz monitor → 120 FPS (50%), 80 FPS (33%), 60 FPS (25%).
[*] Cutscene Performance: Controls FPS in cutscenes, menus, replays, and set-piece cameras.
Half Frame Rate: 50% of refresh rate or frame limit.
Full Frame Rate: Matches your frame rate limit. Disabled when VSync is fractional.
[/list]
[h3]Scaling Tools[/h3]
[list]
[*] Render Scale (NEW): Adjusts render resolution relative to screen resolution.
Below 100% = better performance, less sharp
Above 100% = sharper visuals, heavier GPU load.
[*] Dynamic Resolution Scaling (DRS): Lowers resolution dynamically to maintain FPS (GPU-limited only).
[*] Dynamic Resolution FPS Target: Set the FPS you want DRS to maintain.
Example: Target 90 FPS → resolution scales in real time to stay near 90 FPS.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702522/8fbe8fbf9642ee1068364628ac5803c6305b3930.png[/img]

[h2]Graphics Settings Guide[/h2]

The game will need to be restarted for changes to graphics settings to take effect.

[h3]Graphics Presets (NEW)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Auto: Optimized for your hardware.
[*] Low: Best for minimum-spec PCs.
[*] Medium: Balanced visuals and performance.
[*] High: Improved fidelity for stronger PCs.
[*] Ultra: Maximum detail for top-tier hardware.
[/list]
[h3]Fidelity Settings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rendering Quality: Controls detail and lighting on players, stadiums, and objects.
CPU: Heavy use
GPU: Heavy use
VRAM: Heavy use
[*] Strand Based Hair: Simulates individual strands of hair.
CPU: Moderate use
GPU: Heavy use
VRAM: Low use
[*] Cloth Quality: Determines jersey look and physics.
CPU: Heavy use
GPU: Moderate use
VRAM: Low use
[*] Ambient Occlusion Quality: Adds depth and realism with shading.
CPU: Heavy use
GPU: Heavy use
VRAM: Moderate use

[h3]Stadium Settings[/h3]

[*] Grass Quality: Controls pitch detail.
CPU: Low use
GPU: Moderate use
VRAM: Low use
[*] Crowd Quality: Controls crowd detail and animation.
CPU: Moderate use
GPU: Moderate use
VRAM: Moderate use

[h3]Visual Extras[/h3]

[*] Motion Blur: Slight blur on fast-moving objects.
CPU: Low use
GPU: Low use
VRAM: Low use

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702522/cd42f23b2287014eec45a03a9067bce81bd63701.png[/img]

[h2]PC Requirements[/h2]
Here are the minimum and recommended PC specifications for FC 26 so you can prepare your setup accordingly:


[*] Minimum (720p, 60 FPS gameplay, Low preset)
OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit, latest update)
CPU: Intel Core i5-6600k or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
Memory: 8 GB RAM
GPU: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD RX 570 (4 GB VRAM)
Storage: 100 GB
DirectX: Version 12
Network: Broadband Internet connection

[*] Recommended (1080p, 60 FPS gameplay, Medium preset)
OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit, latest update)
CPU: Intel Core i7-6700 or AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
Memory: 12 GB RAM
GPU: NVIDIA GTX 1660 or AMD RX 5600 XT (6 GB VRAM)
Storage: 100 GB
DirectX: Version 12
Network: Broadband Internet connection

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702522/fe739d8887d0d1922b95d4bc0e86670093b1a2db.jpg[/img]

[h2]EA Javelin Anticheat[/h2]

You’ve told us how important it is to tackle cheating on PC, and it remains one of our top priorities as we keep developing and refining solutions to protect fair play.

For FC 26 on PC, we’re continuing to protect fair play with EA Javelin Anticheat.

[h3]What EA Javelin Anticheat Does[/h3]
EA Javelin Anticheat aims to prevent, identify, and address bad experiences wherever possible. It’s active in FC 26 from day one and is always working in the background when you’re playing.

[h3]What’s New for FC 26[/h3]

[*] Refined Detection Methods: EA Javelin Anticheat now includes new classes of detections that make it better at spotting unfair play.
[*] Improved Fair Play Controls: FC 26 has more controls to verify that EA Javelin Anticheat is running and hasn’t been tampered with whenever you play, preventing various forms of unfair play.

[h3]Kernel-Level Protection[/h3]

Some cheats run at the deepest level of a computer’s operating system, which can make them almost invisible to traditional detection methods. EA Javelin Anticheat runs at the kernel level so it can spot and block those cheats effectively. For FC players, this means:

[*] EA Javelin Anticheat only runs when EA SPORTS FC 26 is active on your PC.
[*] If you uninstall FC 26 (and any other EA games that use EA Javelin Anticheat), the driver also uninstalls.

[h2]Share Your Feedback[/h2]

We’re committed to making sure the PC experience feels just as smooth, fair and optimized as any other platform. Your feedback is essential, so please use the [url=https://www.ea.com/nl/games/ea-sports-fc/fc-26/features/feedback]FC Feedback Hub[/url] and join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/easportsfc]EA SPORTS FC Discord [/url]to provide feedback directly for our teams.
